conduct: Content that has been reported by a user and that the platform considers 'priority harmful content'. The categories are defined elsewhere in the Act, not on these pages. Creators should expect such videos to be blocked for all users quickly after a report.
platform_duty: If a user report is not dismissed under s21(3) or (6) and the provider thinks the content is priority harmful content, it must immediately make the content inaccessible to all users for a period still to be prescribed. Before that period ends, it must decide on reasonable grounds whether the content really is priority harmful content. If it is, the provider must make it permanently inaccessible to all users within a period still to be prescribed. If it is not, the provider may restore it. Under s22(4), any action must be notified in writing to both the reporting user and the user who posted the content. Under s22(5) on page 24, an aggrieved user, including the creator, may ask the provider to look into the action within a period still to be prescribed.
quote: the licensed applications service provider or licensed content applications service provider shall immediately make the content inaccessible on its service to all users for a period as may be prescribed.

conduct: Content that has been reported by a user and that the platform considers 'harmful content' (not priority harmful content). The categories are defined elsewhere in the Act, not on these pages.
platform_duty: If a user report is not dismissed under s21(3) or (6) and the provider thinks the content is harmful content, it may (not must) make the content inaccessible to all users, within a period and for a period still to be prescribed. If it does, it must decide on reasonable grounds before that period ends whether the content really is harmful content.
quote: the licensed applications service provider or licensed content applications service provider may make the content inaccessible on its service to all users within and for a period as may be prescribed.

conduct: Content suspected to be harmful content, in relation to child users. Services likely to be accessed by children must keep identified child users from seeing such content. This may restrict who can see a creator's videos, for example through age-gating.
platform_duty: Under s18(1) and (3), the provider must implement the measures set out in the code to ensure child users can use the service safely. On services likely to be accessed by children, these must include measures to prevent a user identified as a child from accessing content suspected to be harmful content. Other required measures are limiting adult-child communication, limiting features that extend use by children, stopping adults from viewing children's personal information, and controlling recommendation systems for child users. Under s18(2), the provider may use alternative measures if it proves to the Commission that they work better. No timeframe is specified on this page.
quote: to prevent access of a user identified to be a child to a content suspected to be a harmful content

conduct: Harmful content in general. Platforms must reduce the risk of users being exposed to it, which may lead to content being moderated or downranked under the platform's code-based measures.
platform_duty: The provider must implement the measures set out in the code to mitigate the risk of users being exposed to harmful content. Under s13(2), it may use alternative measures if it proves to the Commission that they work better. Under s13(3), the measures must not unreasonably or disproportionately limit a user's expression. No timeframe is specified on this page.
quote: A licensed applications service provider and licensed content applications service provider shall implement the measures as specified in the code to mitigate the risk of users being exposed to harmful content.

conduct: Content that a user reported to a licensed platform, that the platform made inaccessible pending review, and that the platform then determines is 'harmful content' as defined elsewhere in the Act. The categories are not listed on this page.
platform_duty: If the platform determines the reported content is harmful content, it must make it permanently inaccessible to all users on its service within the period as may be prescribed. If it determines the content is not harmful, it must make it accessible again within the prescribed period. It must notify both the reporting user and the user who posted the content in writing (s.23(4)). The poster may ask the platform to review the decision within the prescribed period (s.23(5)-(7)).
penalty: Not specified on this page for this subsection. Section 23(9) (page 26) penalises only the platform, and only for failing to comply with a Commission instruction under s.23(8). No penalty on the creator is stated.
quote: is a harmful content, the licensed applications service provider or licensed content applications service provider shall, within the period as may be prescribed, make the harmful content be permanently inaccessible on its service to all users

conduct: Harmful content that a licensed platform has itself determined to be harmful under s.23(2) but has not made inaccessible to all users.
platform_duty: On a written instruction from the Commission issued in the public interest, make the content permanently inaccessible on its service within the period specified in that instruction.
penalty: The platform commits an offence if it fails to comply with the Commission's instruction. On conviction: a fine of up to RM1,000,000, plus up to RM100,000 for every day or part of a day the offence continues after conviction. The penalty falls only on the platform; no creator penalty is stated.
quote: fails to comply with a written instruction issued by the Commission under subsection (8) commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding one million ringgit

conduct: Content on a licensed platform's service that the Commission determines, after a user report, to be harmful content, including priority harmful content.
platform_duty: On a written instruction from the Commission, make the content permanently inaccessible on its service to all users within the period specified in the instruction. Notify the Commission in writing of the action taken (s.25(2)). Notify the user who posted the content in writing of the action taken (s.25(3)).
penalty: The platform commits an offence if it fails to comply. On conviction: a fine of up to RM1,000,000, plus up to RM100,000 for every day or part of a day the offence continues after conviction (s.25(4), page 29). The penalty falls only on the platform; no creator penalty is stated.
quote: requiring the licensed applications service provider or licensed content applications service provider to make the content permanently inaccessible on its service to all users within the period as may be specified in the written instruction

conduct: Content available online somewhere other than a licensed platform's service (for example, a site or platform not licensed in Malaysia) that the Commission determines, after a user report, to be harmful content, including priority harmful content. Such content can be blocked at network level in Malaysia.
platform_duty: On a written instruction from the Commission, the relevant licensed network service provider must restrict the relevant parts of its network service, within the period specified in the instruction, so that the content is permanently inaccessible to all users. It must notify the Commission in writing of the action taken (s.25(2)).
penalty: A network service provider that fails to comply commits an offence. On conviction: a fine of up to RM1,000,000, plus up to RM100,000 for every day or part of a day the offence continues after conviction (s.25(4), page 29). The penalty falls only on the provider; no creator penalty is stated.
quote: requiring the licensed network service provider to restrict the relevant parts of its network service within the period as may be specified in the written instruction so as to make the content permanently inaccessible to all users

conduct: Content that a licensed platform has reasonable grounds to believe is 'priority harmful content' as defined elsewhere in the Act. The platform can act on this whether or not anyone has reported the content.
platform_duty: The platform may, on its own motion, make the content inaccessible on its service in any manner it decides. This is a power, not a mandatory duty, and no timeframe is specified on this page. If it does so, it must notify the user who posted the content in writing (s.26(2)). That user may ask the platform to review the decision within the prescribed period (s.26(3)).
penalty: Not specified on this page. No creator penalty is stated.
quote: on its own motion make any content inaccessible on its service in the manner as it may determine if the licensed applications service provider or licensed content applications service provider has reasonable grounds to believe that the content is a priority harmful content

section: First Schedule, para 1 (read with Second Schedule)
conduct: Child sexual abuse material, as provided for under section 4 of the Sexual Offences against Children Act 2017 [Act 792]. It is listed as 'harmful content' for section 4. The Second Schedule (page 66) also makes it 'priority harmful content'.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content on child sexual abuse material as provided for under section 4 of the Sexual Offences against Children Act 2017

section: First Schedule, para 2 (read with Note (a) and Second Schedule)
conduct: Content on financial fraud, listed as 'harmful content' for section 4. The Second Schedule (page 66) also makes it 'priority harmful content'. Under Note (a) on page 66, content that promotes awareness or education about financial fraud is not covered.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)

conduct: Obscene content, including lewd portrayals that may cause disgust or offend a person's sense of decency and modesty. Under Note (b) on page 66, content that portrays private parts for educational, scientific or medical purposes is not obscene.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Obscene content including content that may give rise to a feeling of disgust due to lewd portrayal which may offend a person’s manner on decency and modesty

conduct: Indecent content, including content that is profane, improper or against generally accepted behaviour or culture. Under Note (b) on page 66, content that portrays private parts for educational, scientific or medical purposes is not indecent.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Indecent content including content which is profane in nature, improper and against generally accepted behavior or culture

conduct: Content that may cause harassment, distress, fear or alarm through threatening, abusive or insulting words, communications or acts.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content that may cause harassment, distress, fear or alarm by way of threatening, abusive or insulting words or communication or act

conduct: Content that may incite violence or terrorism.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content that may incite violence or terrorism

conduct: Content that may induce a child to harm themselves.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content that may induce a child to cause harm to himself

conduct: Content that may promote ill-will or hostility among the public at large, or that may disturb public tranquillity.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content that may promote feelings of ill-will or hostility amongst the public at large or may disturb public tranquility

conduct: Content that promotes the use or sale of dangerous drugs. Under Note (c) on page 66, content that promotes awareness or education about drug abuse is not covered.
platform_duty: not specified on this page (these pages only define the harmful-content category; the duties are in other sections of the Act)
quote: Content that promotes the use or sale of dangerous drugs
